records.title: FungalLink: fungal genome-to-measured-metabolite benchmark data
records.description: Versioned evidence records and measured-feature candidate sets for evaluating fungal genome-to-metabolite linking. The current private inventory contains 30 admitted relationships across 16 BGC/GCF query identities. Saved complete evaluations cover 11 relationships across seven query views in one conservative analysis group. Nineteen relationships lack complete evaluated coverage. Completed partial-input diagnostics score 291 of 1,249 candidates for 6-MSA and 89 of 98 for ilicicolin H; neither counts as complete coverage. Seventeen FAC/HEx relationships lack usable expression-screen inputs. Unknown candidates remain unlabeled, and chemical-resolution and prior-exposure limits are retained. Final deposited coverage must be reconciled with the approved file allowlist.

records.title: FungalLink: benchmark evaluation software
records.description: Software for declared genome-to-measured-feature candidate ranking, tie-aware evaluation, multiple supported products, missing-input coverage, baseline comparisons and an external-adapter example. Synthetic examples test the interface and do not establish fungal method performance. The existing private software subset has an extracted same-host execution receipt; this does not establish independent external reproduction.
